career_ladder.note: Forest Guard (Van Rakshak) and Wildlife Guard (Vanya Jeev Rakshak) are frontline uniformed protection personnel under the Department of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of Uttar Pradesh. They protect reserve forests, sanctuaries, and national parks from encroachment, illegal logging, and poaching, advancing through seniority and departmental promotion examinations.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment process consists of PET shortlisting, a written examination, rigorous physical standard and endurance tests, and a medical examination. The written examination carries 200 marks with 1/4th negative marking (0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer).

financial_package.note: Forest Guard and Wildlife Guard are positioned at Pay Level 2 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹1,900) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. Recruits are eligible for special uniform allowances and remote beat duty allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Forest Department & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 2
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,900 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,600 to ₹3,200), forest remote beat duty allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,144) and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or government forest colony barracks accommodation
Annual uniform maintenance and kit allowance
Washing allowance and forest beat duty allowance
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
